ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black) pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels occupy approximately 15% as localized speckling and edge highlights.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark field across both lobes; localized high-contrast white patches at the inner median notch borders; high-density white micro-speckling cluster in the lower-central and mid-right lobe regions; distinct dark curvilinear mark on the upper-left quadrant of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 48 degrees and a narrow vertex depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; left lobe displays roughly 10 primary peaks of variable amplitude; right lobe displays roughly 14 sharper, more densely packed peaks with deeper interstitial valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the primary trailing edge trailing toward the lateral tips, with an abrupt upward/dorsal terminal sweep at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread distribution of circular, high-intensity white pixel clusters (1-4 pixels diameter) consistent with barnacle scar footprints, densely concentrated in the central lower half and right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, dark-toned diagonal linear mark (approx. 200 pixels in length) on the upper right lobe; a secondary, darker horizontal crescent mark on the upper left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular, jagged tissue indentation and concentrated white scarring on the distal tip of the right lobe; significant white calloused texture at the inner median notch junction.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive 'salt-and-pepper' stippling effect created by hundreds of individual white micro-pixels scattered across the black pigment field.
